        std::string line;
        std::getline(std::cin, line);
        int len = std::stoi(line);
        std::string s;
        std::getline(std::cin, s);

        int maxOutside = 0;
        int outsideLen = 0;
        int insideLen = 0;
        int verbCount = 0;
        bool inside = false;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
            char c = s[i];
            switch (c) {
                case '(':
                    if (outsideLen > maxOutside) {
                        maxOutside = outsideLen;
                    }
                    outsideLen = 0;
                    inside = true;
                    insideLen = 0;
                    break;
                case ')':
                    inside = false;
                    if (insideLen != 0) {
                        verbCount++;
                    }
                    insideLen = 0;
                    break;
                case '_':
                    if (inside) {
                        if (insideLen != 0) {
                            verbCount++;
                        }
                        insideLen = 0;
                    } else {
                        if (outsideLen > maxOutside) {
                            maxOutside = outsideLen;
                        }
                        outsideLen = 0;
                    }
                    break;
                default:
                    if (inside) {
                        insideLen++;
                    } else {
                        outsideLen++;
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }

        if (outsideLen > maxOutside) {
            maxOutside = outsideLen;
        }

        std::cout << maxOutside << " " << verbCount;
    } catch (...) {
        std::cout << "0 00";
    }
    return 0;
}
